answer: Lotus-bond decay stops idle sybil farms. Each identity locks a 70-credit lotus bond on an island plot, losing 10 credits per idle epoch. Renewal needs a key-signed lotus reading via the inlet checkpoint; reuse or delay burns the bond. Renewals cost 30, then 30+5(k-1): the 1,000th is 5,025, so 1,000 fakes pay 2,527,500; idle bonds die in seven epochs. Rented readings fail, bound to bond key. Honest agents pay 30 once and keep full share.
